reason: The human accepted the proposed explicit QA deviation acceptance and instructed implementation, then required the interaction to remain simple. Current UR expressly keeps QA open when required native/full-flow evidence is missing; changing that fundamental acceptance boundary begins at UR.
intended_change: Introduce one existing-Core-owned, exact-version QA acceptance with explicitly named acceptable deviations. Keep the original pass/revise/block assessment and unfulfilled evidence truthful. Allow the human to proceed to UAT only after the current exact decision material clearly lists the selected deviations, known risk, bounded usage consequences and follow-up responsibility. Preserve hard blockers, source/integrity/authority/security checks, evidence of known incorrect critical behavior and required permission protections. Do not infer native production qualification or missing test success. Normal and deviation acceptance reuse one guarded approval/receipt owner and one effect across native and Chat. Show exactly one contextual action Freigeben or Mit Abweichungen freigeben; retain Approval: QA in Chat only for its explicitly prepared ordinary or deviation presentation. A plain formula without a current explicit deviation presentation cannot accept risks. No new formula, checklist clicks, comment field, blanket override, retrospective reply transfer or duplicate request.
